semantics.timing: f responds to current x without clock or registered latency; allow combinational settling in tests
semantics.dont_care: Either binary output is permitted for each d cell

numeric.arithmetic: Boolean function only; no rounding, saturation, accumulation, or overflow

verification.oracle: Original map stored as a row/column table, independent of RTL equation
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 16 binary input combinations in ascending and descending order; compare all nine specified cells and require binary output on seven d cells
verification.settling: Wait one simulation time unit after each input change
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite external timeouts
verification.success: No mismatches and explicit PASS marker

specification_ambiguities.issue: Port list gives width but no vector range
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use [4:1] because the map explicitly names x[1], x[2], x[3], x[4]
